The '''Skirmish on Corulag''' was a minor confrontation on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corulag/Legends|Corulag]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] between [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] agents and the forces of [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] [[Central Commander]] [[Sollaine]] for Rebel deep-cover [[Spy/Legends|spy]] [[Rivoche Tarkin]].
